{{Quote|Ah, Number Two—There was a serious problem on your last report.''"<br />"''Yes, sir?''"<br />"''Whilst the content was adequate, you failed to use the correct font&hellip;|Captain Cautious and [[Number Two]]|<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 23">[[Star Wars (1998) 23|''Star Wars'' (1998) 23]]</ref>}}
"'''Captain Cautious'''" was the nickname given to the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Captain Cautious's freighter|freighter]] which made routine freight jobs for the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]]. He was known for being indecisive when it came to important decisions, but a stickler for detail. He panicked when his ship was destroyed by the [[Infinity Gate]].
